author: theflashback02
quote: Played for hours and honestly shocked how much hype went into this just to get sluggish 30 FPS performance with drops in action, clunky controls and tedious realism chores instead of fun GTA chaos. Worse yet, pushing all-digital and killing real physical ownership at steep prices is a huge anti-consumer step backward. Shiny graphics don't fix bad design or greedy practices. Disgusting company, disgusting practices, disgusting game. Shame on Rockstar.
